title: Unique Function Names
concept: XIOM does not support function overloading — each function must have a unique name. Use descriptive names instead.
why: Unique names eliminate ambiguity. The compiler always knows exactly which function you mean.
tips: Include the type in the name to disambiguate: `print_int`, `print_str`
Long, clear names > short, clever names
XIOM's explicitness helps prevent accidental wrong-function calls
common_mistakes: Trying to define two functions with the same name but different parameters
Using overly generic names like `process` or `handle` for everything
Creating dozens of nearly-identical functions — consider if they're truly different
